d:
Height seems to be a big topic for some people. In the past several years, other than general fitness questions, "can I get taller?" is one of the MOST common questions I get.
This video is based off the common discussion points I see and hear.
Can exercises and stretches increase our height? Kind of. Stretches and posture exercises can make you appear taller, but I don't know of any exercises that can actually lengthen you long-term (especially after you're an adult). Hanging from a bar decompresses your spine a bit, but this usually fluctuates.
